answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue: it reports qualified revenue from established customers with no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 directly supports pipeline quality and enterprise conversion, though long-term revenue sustainability is not stated. Memories 31, 86, and 91 show durable or early activation improvements, but omit direct revenue, qualification, and retention evidence. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift from promotional pricing, but provides no evidence of long-term sustainability or account quality and may attract price-sensitive, lower-value accounts.
